summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly share repurchase transactions under a buyback program approved by shareholders (May 22, 2024) and the supervisory board. For the period June 29–July 3, 2026, the company bought 145,390 shares (0.02% of issued capital) at a weighted average price of €63.5445 per share, total €9.24M. The repurchases are made by a broker on Euronext Paris to meet obligations under share-based employee compensation plans. After these transactions, treasury shares total 18.88M, representing 2.1% of issued capital. This is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing capital return activity.
